title: Lines to Impress a Girl on Chat: 100 Openers and Replies
h1: Lines to Impress a Girl on Chat: 100 Openers, Replies and Flirty Texts
description: 100 lines to impress a girl on chat: fresh openers, playful flirty texts, sweet compliments and conversation keepers, plus tips for sounding like yourself.
keyword: lines to impress a girl on chat
excerpt: 100 lines to impress a girl on chat, from clever openers and funny icebreakers to sweet compliments, plus how to use them without sounding scripted.
intro:
Texting someone new is a strange mix of excitement and overthinking. You want to stand out from the dozens of “hey” messages she’s probably ignoring, but you also don’t want to come across as trying too hard. The good news is that the best lines to impress a girl on chat aren’t clever tricks. They’re messages that show curiosity, humor and a little warmth.

Below you’ll find 100 lines sorted by situation: openers for dating apps, playful icebreakers, sweet compliments, conversation keepers and smooth ways to ask her out. Use them as they are, or tweak them to match your personality and her profile.
body:
What makes a chat line actually impressive?

A great line does one of three things: it makes her smile, it makes her curious, or it makes her feel noticed. The weakest messages do none of those. They’re generic, overly sexual or all about you.

  • Be specific. Mentioning something from her profile or your last conversation shows real interest.
  • Ask a question. Give her something easy and fun to reply to.
  • Keep it respectful. Skip comments about her body early on. Compliment her style, humor, taste or energy instead.
  • Read the response. If she replies with enthusiasm, keep going. If she gives one-word answers or doesn’t reply, let it go gracefully.
Tip: Copy-paste lines work best as a spark, not a whole conversation. After the opener, switch to genuine questions about her. Our guide on how to start a conversation with a girl explains how.

Openers that beat “hey”

  1. Okay, I have to ask: what’s the story behind your third photo?
  2. Your profile says you love hiking. What’s the best view you’ve ever earned?
  3. Settle a debate for me: is cereal a soup?
  4. I was going to open with a pickup line, but I’d rather hear your best travel story.
  5. Quick question: what’s your go-to karaoke song? This is important research.
  6. You look like someone who has strong opinions about pizza toppings. Am I right?
  7. Two truths and a lie. You go first.
  8. I see you like the same band as me. Which album are you defending to the death?
  9. Your dog is adorable. I’d like to formally request an introduction.
  10. On a scale of one to ten, how good is your coffee order? Be honest.
  11. What’s something you’re weirdly good at?
  12. I like your smile in that last photo. What were you laughing at?
  13. Best taco spot in town. Go.
  14. Your bio made me laugh, which never happens. Nicely done.
  15. If you could be anywhere in the world right now, where would you be?
  16. Rate your weekend so far on a scale from “couch” to “adventure.”

Funny lines to break the ice

  1. I’m not a photographer, but I can definitely picture us arguing about movie rankings.
  2. Is your name Wi-Fi? Because I’m feeling a strong connection.
  3. Do you believe in love at first text, or should I send another one?
  4. I was going to play it cool, but I’ve never been cool in my life.
  5. My mom told me to talk to more interesting people, so here I am.
  6. Are you a magician? Because whenever I read your messages, everyone else disappears.
  7. I’d tell you a chemistry joke, but I’m worried I wouldn’t get a reaction.
  8. Fair warning: I’m about 80 percent puns and 20 percent snacks.
  9. If you were a vegetable, you’d be a cute-cumber. Sorry. I had to.
  10. Do you have a map? I keep getting lost in this conversation.
  11. I’m writing a book on great conversations. Want to help with chapter one?
  12. Are you made of copper and tellurium? Because you’re Cu-Te.
  13. Let’s skip the small talk. What’s the worst haircut you’ve ever had?
  14. Is it hot in here, or is that just my phone overheating from how fast I opened your message?
  15. I’d say God bless you, but it looks like that already happened.
  16. Do you like Star Wars? Because Yoda only one I want to talk to tonight.

Sweet compliments to send over chat

Compliments land best when they’re about something she chose or does. For more ideas, see how to compliment a girl.

  1. You have a way of making a simple conversation feel like the best part of my day.
  2. I love how passionate you get when you talk about your work.
  3. Your laugh must be contagious. I can tell just from how you text.
  4. You have great taste in music. I’ve been listening to your recommendation all day.
  5. Talking to you is so easy. I don’t even have to try to think of things to say.
  6. You’re funnier than you give yourself credit for.
  7. I like how you see the world. It makes me think about things differently.
  8. You have the kind of energy that makes people feel comfortable.
  9. I didn’t expect to be smiling at my phone this much tonight.
  10. You’re really thoughtful. Not many people ask follow-up questions like you do.
  11. Your style is so effortlessly you. I love that.
  12. Honestly, you’re the most interesting person I’ve talked to in a while.
  13. I like that you’re not afraid to be a little weird. Same here.
  14. You have a really good heart. It comes through in the way you talk about people.
  15. I bet you light up any room you walk into.
  16. You make it really hard to put my phone down.

Questions that keep the chat flowing

The fastest way to impress someone is to be genuinely interested in them. Need more? Try our list of great questions to ask a girl.

  1. What’s something that made you smile today?
  2. What’s the best trip you’ve ever taken?
  3. What are you obsessed with right now?
  4. If you had a free Saturday with no obligations, what would you do?
  5. What’s your hidden talent?
  6. Which song could you listen to on repeat forever?
  7. What’s the most spontaneous thing you’ve ever done?
  8. Are you more of a night-in or night-out person?
  9. What’s a goal you’re working toward this year?
  10. What’s your favorite comfort movie?
  11. What was the last thing that made you laugh really hard?
  12. If you could learn any skill instantly, what would it be?
  13. What does your perfect Sunday morning look like?
  14. What’s a small thing that instantly makes your day better?
  15. Do you have a dream travel destination?
  16. What’s one thing people usually get wrong about you?

Flirty lines for when the vibe is right

Use these once she’s flirting back. Playful works. Pushy doesn’t.

  1. I’m trying to focus on my work, but someone keeps distracting me.
  2. Fair warning: if you keep being this charming, I’m going to have to ask you out.
  3. I think my phone has a crush on you. It keeps lighting up every time you text.
  4. You’re trouble. The good kind.
  5. I was going to say goodnight an hour ago. You’re a bad influence.
  6. Okay, you’re officially my favorite notification.
  7. I like you. There, I said it. Your turn.
  8. You’re making it really hard to play it cool right now.
  9. I’ve been smiling at my screen like an idiot. Thanks for that.
  10. Is it weird that I already miss talking to you and we’re still talking?
  11. Something tells me you’re going to be a very good story one day.
  12. You plus me plus a good coffee shop sounds like a solid plan.
  13. Careful, I’m starting to look forward to your texts a little too much.
  14. You have no idea how hard I just laughed at that.
  15. I’d tell you you’re cute, but I think you already know.
  16. Every time I think this conversation can’t get better, you prove me wrong.

Smooth ways to ask her out over chat

  1. I’m having way too much fun talking to you. Want to continue this over coffee?
  2. You mentioned you’ve never tried that ramen place. Let’s fix that this week.
  3. I feel like this conversation would be even better in person. Are you free Thursday?
  4. I’d love to hear the rest of that story face to face. Drinks this weekend?
  5. Let’s settle the pizza debate properly. I know a great spot.
  6. Want to grab a bite and see if we’re as fun in person as we are over text?
  7. There’s a night market on Saturday. Want to come check it out with me?
  8. No pressure, but I’d really like to take you out sometime.

Goodnight and good-morning texts

  1. Good morning! Hope your coffee is strong and your day is easy.
  2. Goodnight. Thanks for making my evening so much better.
  3. Sleep well. I’ll be thinking about that terrible joke you made.
  4. Morning! Just wanted to be the first person to wish you a great day.
  5. Sweet dreams. Talk tomorrow?
  6. Rise and shine. Today’s going to be a good one, I can feel it.
  7. Goodnight! Don’t let the bad jokes bite. That’s my job.
  8. Morning, sunshine. Big plans today or a slow one?
  9. Hope today treats you as nicely as you treated my evening yesterday.
  10. Off to sleep. Hope you dream about pizza and good music.
  11. Good luck today. You’ve got this, and I’ll want to hear all about it.
  12. Before I crash, I just wanted to say I really liked talking to you.

Chat habits that impress more than any line

  • Reply at a natural pace. No need for strategic waiting games. Just don’t flood her with messages.
  • Match her energy. If she sends short replies, keep yours shorter. If she writes paragraphs, feel free to open up.
  • Remember details. Bringing up something she said days ago is hugely impressive.
  • Don’t push. If she says no, isn’t interested or stops replying, respect it. No guilt trips, no repeated follow-ups.
  • Move offline when it’s natural. Chat is a bridge to meeting, not a replacement for it.

For more fun lines, browse our full pickup lines collection or check out how to impress a girl in person.
takeaways: Specific, curious openers beat generic greetings and cheesy lines every time.
Compliment her personality, taste or humor rather than her body early on.
Use lines as a spark, then switch to genuine questions and real conversation.
Match her energy and respect it gracefully if she isn’t interested.

faq.q: What is the best first message to send a girl?
faq.a: The best first message is specific and easy to answer. Reference something from her profile or your shared context, then ask a light question, like the story behind a photo or her opinion on something she mentioned. It shows you paid attention and gives her an easy, fun way to reply.

faq.q: How do I impress a girl over text without being cheesy?
faq.a: Focus on curiosity and humor rather than heavy pickup lines. Ask thoughtful questions, remember details she shares, compliment things like her taste or sense of humor, and keep the tone relaxed. A playful cheesy line can work occasionally, especially if you acknowledge it’s cheesy.

faq.q: How long should I text a girl before asking her out?
faq.a: There’s no fixed rule, but once you’ve had a few good back-and-forth conversations and she seems engaged, it’s usually a good time to suggest meeting. Texting for weeks without a plan can fizzle out. Keep the invitation casual and specific, such as coffee or a walk.

faq.q: What should I avoid saying to a girl on chat?
faq.a: Avoid sexual comments early on, negative remarks about her looks or other women, guilt trips when she replies slowly, and long monologues about yourself. Also avoid pushing after she declines. Respectful, curious and fun messages are always the safer and more attractive choice.
